# `aitbc market offer-disable`

Disable/unregister a market offer.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc market offer-disable [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--plugin-id` | text | — | yes | Plugin ID to disable |
| `--output` | choice | — | no | Output format (alias for --format) |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc market offer-disable --plugin-id <plugin_id>
aitbc market offer-disable --plugin-id <plugin_id> --output json
```
